name: Midnight Gradient
tagline: Words land one at a time on near-black, the hero word burns in a pink-to-violet gradient, UI glows.
description: A social-first product promo language: a near-black stage, white sans words arriving one at a time from scattered letters, outline words that fill, a hero word in a hot pink → orange → violet gradient with an echo trail and confetti dots, a glowing input pill whose gradient rings pulse outward, round gradient feature icons, dark app UI cards that stack and scroll, and a lens-flare streak inside a glass tile for the app reveal. Long continuous shots with a few hard cuts; the energy comes from the type.

signature: letter assembly: a word builds from letters scattered across the frame that fly to their places, and scatters back out
gradient ignition: a white or outlined word fills with the pink-orange-violet gradient while a dark echo of it slides behind and confetti dots pop
ring pulse: gradient rings pulse out from a glowing control and carry the eye into the next scene
avoid: rainbow gradients beyond the pink-orange-violet family

camera: Mostly locked with slow drifts. UI lists scroll vertically, a pill slides in from the edge, and push-ins happen through the ring pulse. A white flash page breaks the dark once.

texture.notes: Deep near-black with a hint of violet. Light comes from the content: soft glows behind gradient UI, a warm lens-flare streak, small blurred bokeh. Thin dashed guides (circles, boxes) appear around outline words.

lighting: Emissive: gradients glow on black, glass tiles catch a rim light, a flare streak blooms from the centre.
sound: Modern pop/electronic bed with a steady beat; whooshes and soft risers under letter flights, pops and sparkles on confetti, a deep hit on the gradient word.

beats.label: Glowing pill slides in, rings pulse
Gradient hero word, flare tile, scatter

motionSummary: Moves like a premium social promo: words assemble from flying letters on black, the hero word ignites in a hot gradient with an echo trail, and glowing UI pulses rings into the next idea.

composition: one word or one UI element centred on black, generous space
a small persistent corner mark (the product's logo and handle) as a frame anchor
full-width moments only for the hero word and the white flash page
visual.shapeLanguage: rounded: pills, round icons, rounded cards and glass tiles; thin dashed circles and boxes as guides; small squares and dots as confetti
visual.contrast: near-black stage with white type; colour only in gradients (hero word, icons, pill border, rings) and confetti

grammar.pacing: one word per beat (8–20 f per word) with longer 1–2 s UI moments; 1–2 cuts per 10 s, the rest is motion inside the shot
grammar.rhythm: beat-driven words, syncopated confetti pops, rings pulsing on the downbeat
grammar.easing: expo-out arrivals ([0.16,1,0.3,1]), quick in-out moves, soft springs on letters and pops
grammar.acceleration: letters launch fast and decelerate long into place; exits accelerate away
movement: letters flying from scattered positions into a word
outline word filling with white or gradient
gradient sweep along a pill border
echo trail of a big dark word sliding behind
grammar.density: low: one element at a time, with sparse confetti around hero moments
grammar.holds: short (6–14 f) on each word, longer on UI so it can be read

transitionPresets.name: Letter assembly
transitionPresets.build: place each letter of the next word at a random spot in the frame (scaled 0.6–1.4, rotated ±25°); spring them to their places with a 1–2 f stagger; to exit, reverse with exit ease

transitionPresets.name: Gradient ignition
transitionPresets.build: the word sits white or as a dashed outline; a gradient wipes through its fill left → right (10–14 f) while a big dark copy slides behind it as an echo and 8–14 confetti dots pop around
transitionPresets.sound: a deep hit with a sparkle

transitionPresets.name: Ring pulse
transitionPresets.build: two to four gradient rings expand from a button or icon past the frame edge (14–24 f, camera ease); the next scene is revealed inside the last ring

transitionPresets.name: Pill morph
transitionPresets.build: a pill shrinks and splits into round gradient icons (or icons merge into a pill), the gradient carried across

transitionPresets.name: List scroll
transitionPresets.build: dark rounded cards stream up through the frame with slight scale by distance from centre; the next word enters on the same upward motion

transitionPresets.name: Flash page
transitionPresets.build: a hard cut to a white page (a collage, a word) for 1–2 s, then a black circle irises back to the dark stage

archetypes.name: Word beat
archetypes.purpose: the message, one word at a time
archetypes.composition: one short word or phrase centred on black, white sans
archetypes.elements: a word, optional dashed outline guides, drifting small squares
archetypes.motion: letters assemble from scattered positions, outline fills, then scatter out

archetypes.name: Glow pill
archetypes.purpose: the product interaction: type, ask, generate
archetypes.composition: a large rounded input pill across the centre with a gradient send button
archetypes.elements: pill with a moving gradient border light, typing caret and text, a glowing button
archetypes.motion: slides in from the edge, text types, the button glows and rings pulse out

archetypes.name: Feature row
archetypes.purpose: what it does: two to four features
archetypes.composition: a row of round gradient icons with small labels under them, confetti dots around
archetypes.elements: gradient circles with white glyph icons, labels
archetypes.motion: icons pop in left to right, dots pop and drift

archetypes.name: Gradient hero
archetypes.composition: one big word in the pink-orange-violet gradient, a dark echo of it behind, confetti dots
archetypes.elements: hero word, echo word, 8–14 coloured dots
archetypes.motion: ignites from white or outline, echo slides past, dots pop

archetypes.name: App reveal
archetypes.purpose: the product and where to get it
archetypes.composition: a glass tile centred with a lens-flare streak inside, resolving to the app icon and a handle or name below
archetypes.elements: rounded glass tile, warm flare streak, the app icon, a name line
archetypes.motion: the flare blooms and narrows, the tile settles, the icon fades up

beats.motion: flare in a glass tile, then the first words
word beats between UI moments; pill → icons

beats.purpose: how much: all your work, in one place
beats.motion: list scroll and quick word beats, a white flash page
the hero word ignites with echo and confetti

sequence.cutRhythm: few cuts (1–2 per 10 s); words change on every beat inside long shots; one white flash page

scenes.action: a warm flare streak blooms inside a glass tile on black, small pink squares drift
'one app' assembles from scattered letters as a dashed outline, then fills white
the input pill slides in, 'make a lo-fi beat' types, the send button glows and gradient rings pulse out
the pill splits into three gradient icons: music, speech, images; confetti dots pop
'without' in outline, then 'limits' ignites in the gradient with a dark echo sliding behind
the letters gather into the app icon; the name types below

elements.text: one word or a short phrase at a time, lower case, white; one hero word per film in the gradient; outline/dashed words for contrast
elements.logo: small and persistent in a corner as a frame anchor; full size only in the app reveal
elements.icons: round gradient badges with white line glyphs
elements.images: only on the white flash page, as a loose collage of rounded photos, sometimes duotoned in the gradient
elements.ui: dark rounded UI: an input pill, list cards, a phone home screen; real product UI in the film's colours
elements.shapes: pills, circles, rounded tiles, dashed guide circles and boxes
elements.background: near-black, one white flash page at most
elements.particles: small squares and dots in the gradient colours, drifting or popping

audio.sync: each word lands on a beat; confetti pops on off-beats; ring pulses on the downbeat; the hero word on the strongest hit
audio.sfx: whooshes for letter flights, pops and sparkles for confetti, a soft swell for rings, a deep hit for the gradient word, a bright hit for the flash page
